# Dwarves
Dwarves are similar to humans in most respects, albeit on the shorter side.
## Unique Abilities
### Honed Instincts
- Their sharp mining instincts allow them to feel nearby ore in a 3 tile radius.
## Diet
- They are not poisoned by alcohol and instead are even [color=#1e90ff]slightly healed[/color] by it.
## Benefits
- They are slightly smaller than humans, though are also slightly heavier.
## Drawbacks
- They [color=#FFA500]suffocate two times faster.[/color]
